setup: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Cross your right ankle over your left knee, creating a figure-four shape with your legs.
steps: Reach through your legs and grasp the back of your left thigh with both hands.
Gently pull your left thigh toward your chest until you feel a comfortable stretch in your right glute and outer hip.
Hold the position steadily without bouncing.
Lower your legs back to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
instructions.breathing: Breathe slowly and deeply, using each exhalation to help relax deeper into the stretch.
cues: Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor
Flex the crossed foot to protect your knee

common_faults.fault: Lifting the head and upper back off the floor to reach the leg.
common_faults.correction: Keep your head resting flat, or loop a strap or towel around the thigh if your hands cannot reach comfortably.

common_faults.fault: Twisting the pelvis to force extra range of motion.
common_faults.correction: Keep your hips square and your lower back resting flat against the mat.

precautions: Do not force the knee into excessive rotation if you experience knee discomfort.

name: Glute Stretch
summary: A static flexibility exercise performed lying on the back to stretch the gluteal muscles and deep hip rotators.
